title: heracleum sphondylium subsp. orsinii
intro: Heracleum sphondylium subsp. orsinii, commonly known as Italian hogfennel, is a plant species belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). The Italian hogfennel is valued for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, boost the immune system, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Italian hogfennel include its ability to act as a vulnerary, a diuretic, and a carminative, making it useful for wound healing, urinary tract issues, and digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of Italian hogfennel include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
